days.title: No unbreakable agenda
days.text:
### Day 1 · Welcome aboard
Your Expedition Leader meets you at La Paz airport and takes you to the marina, where the crew is waiting. First swim off the stern and dinner at anchor.

### Day 2 · Espíritu Santo
Snorkel, kayak and paddleboard in the coves of Espíritu Santo, a protected national park. Your Expedition Leader chooses the spots that suit the group that day.

### Day 3 · The Bay of La Paz
In February and March, whale sharks feed close to shore in the Bay of La Paz. A long lunch on deck, and an afternoon with nothing scheduled.

### Last day · Back to La Paz
Breakfast at anchor, a final swim, and the sail back to La Paz.
days.note: Your captain sets the route each day according to the wind.

whales.title: The blue whales of Loreto
whales.text:
From January to March, gray, humpback and blue whales arrive in the waters of Baja California Sur. Blue whales, the largest animals on Earth, feed off Loreto, north of La Paz along the same coast.

We can add a day in Loreto with a local guide to look for them, before or after your time on board. Whales are wild: we look for them, but no one can promise a sighting.
whales.internalNote: CONFIRMAR con Thibault: formato y precio de la excursión de ballenas azules en Loreto, y nado con tiburón ballena (incluido o extra)

options.name: Your boat · Lagoon 52
options.intro:
A 52-foot catamaran with five double cabins and a sixth with bunk beds, six bathrooms and air conditioning in every cabin. The flybridge is where everyone gathers to watch the next island get closer. At the stern, a grill, an outside shower and kayaks ready to go in the water.

Once we know who is travelling with whom, couples, families or friends, we'll send you a cabin plan so everyone knows where they sleep before arriving.
options.priceNote: Price for the full boat and the full group.

food.title: What's cooking on board
food.text: Your chef shops in La Paz the day before you board and cooks three meals a day on board: breakfast on deck, lunch at anchor, dinner as the sun goes down. Tell us about allergies or preferences before the trip and the menu is built around them.

aboard.title: What's aboard
onBoard: Your Expedition Leader, with you all days
All meals on board and non-alcoholic drinks
Fuel, navigation and national park permits
Dinghy, 2 paddle boards, double kayak, inflatable platform, snorkel gear for everyone
BBQ, beach shade, chairs and towels
notOnBoard: Alcohol (bring your own, or ask us about our wine selection)
Crew tips (10% of the trip value is customary)
Scuba diving or kite surfing equipment and tanks (on request, book before the trip)

crew.title: The people running the boat
crew.text:
The captain reads the sea. The chef cooks with what Baja has that week. The deckhand handles the dinghy and the anchor. And your Expedition Leader reads the group: when to swim, when to sail, when to leave everyone alone with a coffee on the bow.

You bring the people. We take care of the rest.

book.title: How to book
book.text: The boat is held only once we receive the deposit. These are the terms:
terms: Bank transfer price: payment in USD to the Eagle Ray Expeditions US account. 50% on confirmation and 50% before [DATE TO CONFIRM], or 100% on confirmation.
Card price: payment through a secure payment link. 50% on confirmation and 50% before [DATE TO CONFIRM], or 100% on confirmation. Card processing fees are non-refundable.
This proposal is valid for [VALIDITY TO CONFIRM].
Cancellation: 50% of the amount paid is refunded for cancellations before [DATE TO CONFIRM]. After that date, payments are non-refundable.
Weather: if conditions prevent leaving port, we extend the lost day when the boat's schedule allows. If not, we refund USD 1,600 for each full day lost.
Departures between March 21 and April 4, 2027 (Holy Week) carry a supplement.
Flights and hotel nights before or after the expedition are not included.

closing.title: Ready when you are
closing.text: Tell us how you'd like to pay, and we'll send the booking details the same day.
